tools.clipboardDesc: Everything you copy stays here — text, images and files, one shortcut away.
tools.screenshotDesc: Region capture with pin-to-desktop, OCR and whole-image translation.
tools.launcherDesc: One shortcut opens a search box for apps, folders, scripts and workflows.
tools.phrasesDesc: Save the things you type often and paste them from the launcher.
tools.vaultDesc: Credentials encrypted on this device, readable only after unlocking.
tools.workflowDesc: Wire triggers, scripts and actions into a graph — your own automations.
tools.hotkeyConflict: This shortcut clashes with “{{owner}}” — only one of them will fire. Change one of the two.
tools.shotOcrHint: OCR runs locally; whole-image translation needs a model key.
tools.phraseListHint: Click to edit · drag the handle to reorder · right-click to delete
tools.runtimeDesc: See which Java / Python versions are installed, which one is active, and what's misconfigured.

workspaces.pickOne: Pick a workspace on the left to see its detail
workspaces.hint: A workspace is where the AI writes files. Coding tasks create one per goal automatically; you can also point at an existing folder.
workspaces.noRelatedJobs: No task in this workspace yet
workspaces.descEmpty: No description yet — add a line about what this workspace is for.
workspaces.descFootnote: The description is only for you; it does not affect AI behaviour.
workspaces.dirUnreadable: Cannot read this folder (it may not exist yet, or access is denied)
workspaces.dirNoPath: No path yet (reported by the device after the first run)
workspaces.removeHint2: Remove "{{name}}"? It has {{count}} past task(s); task records are kept.
workspaces.keepFilesHint: All files stay on disk; you can add it back later.
workspaces.wipeFilesHint: Irreversible — everything inside will be permanently deleted.
workspaces.wipeWarn: This will delete {{path}} and everything inside it.
workspaces.fieldPathHint: Leave empty to use a same-named folder under ~/UmbraWorks/ (created if missing).
workspaces.newFootnote: Coding tasks also create workspaces automatically.
workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.empty: No workspaces yet. Tasks create them automatically, or add one manually.
workspaces.notConnected: Device not connected; cannot add workspace
workspaces.purgeLabel: Also delete all files in the workspace
workspaces.purgeHint: Unchecked: only remove from the list, files kept on disk. Checked: delete the directory's files too (irreversible).
workspaces.purgeFailed: Record removed, but files not deleted: {{reason}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Connection, device, permissions and global shortcuts live here. Per-tool options are on each tool's own page under Tools.
settings.hotkeysHint: Overview and conflict detection only — change a shortcut on its own tool page.
settings.hotkeysEmpty: Global shortcuts are unavailable here (no desktop bridge on the web).
settings.hotkeysConflictHint: {{count}} shortcut(s) are duplicated. Only one of a duplicated pair will actually fire, so change one of them.
settings.secConnDesc: How this device authenticates with the Umbra server.
settings.secDeviceDesc: This machine's identity and runtime state as an execution device.
settings.secPermDesc: macOS system grants — revoking one disables the related features.
settings.secKeysDesc: Overview and conflict check only; change a shortcut on its own tool page.
settings.secChatDesc: How the assistant behaves on this device, and its snapshot of you.
settings.secOpsDesc: Per action: Ask / Always allow / Block.
settings.secCapDesc: Programs registered with the server, and the coding execution policy.
settings.appearanceHint: Following the system switches automatically day/night
settings.keysFootnote: Empty means no shortcut is bound. When a combo is duplicated, only one of them fires.
settings.keysConflictBanner: {{count}} duplicate(s) found: the same combo is bound to more than one feature; the later one will not fire.
settings.opsFootnote: "Ask" shows a confirmation card in chat before running.
settings.cuOffBanner: The computer-use master switch is off, so these settings have no effect yet.
settings.codingPermHint: Whether coding tasks may run commands
settings.bootLaunchHint: Starts silently in the background after you log in
settings.trayHint: Stays in the menu bar after the window closes; with it off, closing the window quits
settings.autoApproveOperateHint: When on, computer-control (operate) approval cards are auto-approved instead of asking each time. Use with care.
settings.profileHint: The assistant's current snapshot of you, auto-updated from chats; edit and save, or reset to a blank template
settings.profileResetConfirm: Clear the user profile? It will be reset to a blank template and cannot be undone.
settings.computerAuthSub: Per action: Ask / Always allow / Block
settings.computerUseDesc: Allow AI to operate local apps like a human (off by default)
settings.clipAutoPasteDesc: Auto-paste into the front app after picking an item (off = copy only, paste with ⌘V)
settings.clipClearConfirm: Clear all non-favorite clipboard history? Favorites will be kept.
settings.clipClearFavDesc: Favorites never expire and survive "Clear history" — wipe them here when they pile up
settings.clipClearFavConfirm: Clear all favorited clipboard entries? This cannot be undone.
settings.launcherEnableDesc: Global hotkey to search apps, folder bookmarks, phrases
settings.launcherFolders: Folder bookmarks (open a folder with a chosen app)
settings.launcherYoudaoHint: Create a Text Translation app in Youdao console for appKey/secret. In launcher: 'fy hello'; codecs 'uni/url/b64 <text>'; calc & units inline (e.g. 3*4, 10km to mi).
settings.launcherScriptHint: With a keyword, run 'keyword text' ($1=text); otherwise match by name. stdout is copied.
settings.phrasesSub: Searchable in launcher, Enter to insert
settings.phrasesHint: Search by name/keyword/content in the launcher; Enter inserts the content into the front app (needs Accessibility, else copy only). Click a row to edit, drag the handle to reorder, right-click to delete. Changes sync to the cloud across your devices (stored in plain text — put secrets in the Password Vault).
settings.vaultDesc: Zero-knowledge encrypted passwords / IDs / important files (master password; can pop out to its own window)
settings.clipKeepHint: Entries older than this are removed automatically (counted from last use). Favourites never expire.
settings.phrasesShortcutHint: Opens the clipboard panel on the Snippets tab; press Enter to paste.
settings.secTrashDesc: Deleted items land here first and stay for 30 days before they're cleared. Vault items are kept separately and their titles can't be read while it's locked.
settings.secMoneycatDesc: Renaming only changes the display name — entries store a stable id, so history is untouched. Disabled categories leave the pickers but keep their history.

logs.title: Logs
logs.noneInFilter: No logs in this group yet
logs.emptyBody: Once the device connects and registers, connection events, dispatched tasks and capability runs all show up here.
logs.capNote: Only the latest {{cap}} lines are kept in memory — no paging. Older entries live in the logs folder, one file per day.

tasks.pickOne: Pick a task on the left to see its detail
tasks.checklistFootnote: The completion criteria set when the task was created. Only the criteria are listed — the server does not record per-item pass/fail.
tasks.timelineFootnote: Only the latest 200 events are kept; see the Logs page for the full record.
tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.confirmDelete: Move {{count}} selected tasks to the trash? They stay for 30 days, then go for good.
tasks.retryHint: Resumes from the failed step; finished milestones are not redone
tasks.retryNotReady: Retry is still being debugged and is unavailable in this build.
tasks.deleteBusy: {{count}} of them are still running — stop them first
tasks.deletedToTrash: Moved to trash · kept for 30 days

inspiration.title: Ideas
inspiration.railSubtitle: Quick notes on things worth doing
inspiration.railFootnote: Say “log an idea: …” on any device and the assistant fills in the title and tags for you.
inspiration.emptyHint: Say “log an idea: …” on any device and the assistant fills in the title and tags — or add one manually.
inspiration.confirmDeleteOne: Move this idea to the trash? It stays for 30 days, then goes for good.
inspiration.rawPh: Just write it down — no need to polish it.
inspiration.autoFillHint: Leave the title and tags blank and the assistant will read the content and fill them in.
inspiration.organizingHint: Umbra is filling in the title and tags…
inspiration.researchHint: Have Umbra scout it out: what already exists, where the pitfalls are, whether it's worth doing. A few bullets plus links — not a report.
inspiration.researchRunning: Working on it — usually under a minute. Feel free to come back later.
inspiration.researchQueueFailed: Couldn't queue it. The server may not support this yet, or the connection dropped.
inspiration.researchOnCreateHint: After saving, have Umbra scout it out. You can also trigger this later from the detail pane.
inspiration.deletedToast: Moved to trash · kept for 30 days

abilities.title: Abilities
abilities.notReady: Device engine not ready or no providers.
abilities.footer: Built-in programs work when installed; toggle off programs you don't want AI to use. Custom programs (providers.json) can be edited/deleted, or use Add program without writing JSON.
abilities.builtinHint: Built-in program: only display name and detect command can be overridden; execution still uses built-in logic.
abilities.detectCmd: Detect command (optional, which check; blank = always available)
abilities.skills: Skills (use {param} placeholders; AI fills params only)
abilities.deleteConfirm: Delete the custom program “{{name}}”? The AI will no longer be able to call its skills, and the entry is removed from providers.json.

realtime.title: Realtime
realtime.permIncomplete: Missing permissions: {{missing}} not granted; computer-use cannot run
realtime.idleHint: No computer actions in progress. v0 supports atomic actions (click/type/key/scroll/open app/screenshot); operate autonomy is not yet connected.

chat.placeholder: Type a message. Press / for quick actions, Enter to send
chat.slashFoot: {{n}} actions. Newly connected Skills / MCPs show up here automatically.
chat.slashEmptyBody: Not a capability yet. Once a Skill / MCP is connected it will appear here automatically.
chat.slashActionHint: {{label}}: the grey hint shows what to include — just type over it. Backspace removes the chip.
chat.slashMoneyDesc: Amount and category, done in seconds
chat.slashInspDesc: Save it now; title and tags get filled in for you
chat.slashRemDesc: A time plus what to remind you about
chat.slashRemParams: time and what to remind you about
chat.slashTaskDesc: Describe the goal; Umbra breaks it into steps
chat.ideaBanner: From idea "{{title}}" — "Create task" is filled in for you.
chat.notConnected: Not connected to server. Message not sent. Check server URL in Settings.
chat.clearConfirm: Clear your chat history with the Secretary? This cannot be undone (device conversations are unaffected).
chat.clearConfirmDevice: Clear the conversation record for "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
chat.deviceEmptyHint: Tell {{name}} what to do — the secretary will dispatch the task to this device
chat.noCapabilities: This device hasn't reported any capabilities
chat.forgetConfirm: Remove "{{name}}" from contacts? (It will reappear next time it comes online; chat history is kept.)
chat.deviceOfflineHint: This device is offline; on-device tasks can't run
chat.questionSubmitted: Submitted — the secretary is on it
chat.alwaysAllowed: Won't ask again for this kind of action
chat.clearedElsewhere: Another device cleared this chat history
chat.locateTitle: Stuck — it needs you to point at the right spot
chat.locateHint: It can't locate the target reliably. Click the right spot on the screenshot.
chat.locateFootHint: Click again to move the point. You can also describe what's wrong, or pause and handle it yourself.
chat.locateFbPlaceholder: What's wrong? e.g. "wrong screenshot — that screen isn't open"
chat.locateResumeNoJob: This request carries no task id, so it can't be resumed — handle it from the Tasks page

clipboard.selectHint: Select an item on the left

screenshot.toolSelect: Select (drag to move the region · ⇧drag to marquee · drag an object to move · ⌥drag to duplicate)
screenshot.scrollHint: Scroll the page slowly, then click ✓ (Enter to finish, Esc to cancel)
screenshot.scrollGapWarn: This long image has {{count}} gap(s) and may be missing content — scroll more slowly and try again
screenshot.scrollFailed: Could not start the scrolling capture
screenshot.scrollBusy: A scrolling capture is already running
screenshot.scrollTooShort: Selection is too short for a scrolling capture
screenshot.scrollAutoRunning: Auto-scrolling — leave the mouse alone, it stops at the bottom
screenshot.scrollAtBottom: Reached the bottom — click ✓ to stitch
screenshot.scrollAutoFailed: Auto-scroll unavailable; scrolling by hand still works

electron.screenPermDetail: Enable Umbra under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording (restart app after granting).
electron.ocrUnsupported: OCR is not supported on this system (macOS only)
electron.glmKeyMissing: Zhipu API key not configured (Settings → Screenshot → Translation key)
electron.screenPermDenied: Screen Recording not granted: Settings → Permissions → Screen Recording
electron.accessibilityDenied: Accessibility not granted: Settings → Permissions → Accessibility
electron.skillDenied: The computer action "{{skill}}" is blocked in your settings
electron.operateUnsupported: operate is not connected to the decision engine yet. Supported: open_app / click / type / key / scroll / screenshot.

trash.countLine: {{count}} items · cleared automatically when they expire
trash.footer: Restoring puts an item back where it was. Deleting permanently is final — there is no way back.
trash.emptyBody: Deleted tasks, ideas and reminders land here first and stay for {{days}} days.
trash.purgeBody: It goes nowhere, and there is no way back.
trash.purgeAllBody: The {{count}} items in the general zone will be removed right away. Vault items must be cleared separately after unlocking — they can't be touched from here.
trash.vaultLockedHint: Vault entries are end-to-end encrypted. While it's locked their titles can't be read, and they can't be restored.
trash.purgeBodyVault: The ciphertext goes too, and it disappears from your other devices on their next sync. There is no way back.
trash.purgeAllBodyWithVault: The {{count}} items in the general zone will be removed right away. The {{vault}} vault items must be cleared separately after unlocking — they can't be touched from here.
trash.restoreBody: The item goes back where it was, and stats follow.
trash.restoreBodyVault: The item goes back to its original vault group.

money.errBody: Stats and entries live on the server. Check the network or server status, then retry.
money.emptyBody: Add one and the category breakdown and monthly trend will show up here.
money.deleteBody: It moves to the trash and stays for 30 days — restorable in Settings → Trash. This also removes it from your other devices.
money.cmpNone: No records last month — nothing to compare
money.ringNote: The ring shows only the top 5 categories; the rest merge into “other categories”. The list shows every category with spending this month; ones without a color slot use a gray dot.
money.trendNote: One series (spending), one Y axis. The current month is orange, the rest neutral gray. Only the current bar is labeled — hover for the others.
money.filterEmptyBody: Try another direction or category, or clear the filters.
money.listEmptyBody: Add an entry and it will appear here grouped by day.
money.footHint: Right-click a row to edit or delete
money.addFootHint: The amount accepts expressions; Enter saves
money.saveFailed: Not saved: the server didn't respond. Everything is still here — save again once you're online.
money.slotGrabBody: Slot {{n}} currently belongs to “{{owner}}”. After the switch, “{{owner}}” loses its color in charts and turns neutral gray; lists are unaffected.
money.attDelBody: Only the image is removed; the entry itself stays.
money.attOriginHint: This entry came from a screenshot; the original stays and can't be removed. Other images can be added or removed anytime.
money.attHint: Receipts, bills, transfer screenshots all go here, stored with the entry. Drag in or click "Add image".
money.recFoot: Auto-logged silently with a badge in the list. Pause is reversible; deleting keeps logged entries.
money.recEmpty: No recurring rules yet. Rent, insurance, broadband — set one up and it logs itself until you stop it.
money.recDelBody: It stops logging. The {{n}} entries already logged stay — that money was really spent. If you just want a break, use Pause.
money.recEditHint: Changes only affect the future — logged entries stay.
money.recNewHint: The amount lives in the rule and logs straight in, no confirmation.
money.recSavedNew: Created. It will log on schedule.
money.recMonthEndNote: In months without day {{day}} (like Feb) it logs on the last day instead of skipping.
money.recEndInclusive: End date inclusive: that day still logs, then it stops.
money.recEndBeforeFirst: End date is before the first date ({{first}}) — nothing would ever log.
money.recEndNoDay: No matching day between {{first}} and {{end}} — nothing would ever log. Move the end date or change the cycle.
money.recPrevOnce: Logs once on {{date}} at {{time}}, then stops.
money.recPrevTailEnd: Last entry on {{date}} at {{time}}, then it stops.
money.recPrevTailNone: Nothing would log in this range.
money.recPrevMonth: First on {{month}}/{{day}} at {{time}}, then monthly on day {{day}}, {{tail}}
money.recNeedName: Give the rule a name first
money.recGone: This entry's rule was deleted; the entry stays.
money.newCatSlotHint: All 9 color slots are taken, so new categories start neutral gray. To color it, click "Change slot" in the table and take a slot from another category.
money.subAreaHint: Renaming never touches history; deleting only removes it from future picks — existing entries keep it.
money.subAreaEmpty: No subs yet. Add one to pick a second level under this category.
money.subDelBodyUsed: {{n}} entries use this sub. They stay unchanged — it just won't be pickable anymore.
money.subDelBody: It won't be pickable when adding entries anymore.
money.recDirIncomeHint: Recurring rules on the income side — e.g. salary auto-recorded on the 10th each month.
